lines.text: Jerusalem's origin was Canaanite, with an Amorite father and a Hittite mother, and no one cared for her at birth.
God saw her in her blood and said "Live!", made her thrive, then spread His cloak over her and made a covenant.
God clothed her in embroidered cloth, fine linen and silk, put a bronze helmet on her head, and her fame spread.
Trusting in her beauty, she made idols from her gold and silver and sacrificed her sons and daughters to them.
She prostituted herself with the Egyptians, then the Philistines, then Chaldea, and was finally satisfied.

wrong_details.wrong: the Philistines as her second lovers, after Egypt
